sonnet.problem: The question already holds the answer. It says Ezekiel "warned" the righteous man and the man didn't sin, so the right answer "Because he heeded the warning" is just a form of that wording. Card 10 also sets it up: "warns a righteous man not to sin, and the man doesn't sin. He will indeed live." A baker can pick the answer without reading the passage.
sonnet.rule: A choice card's question never holds its own answer, or a form of it, like "rock badgers" for "in the rocks." Ask something else.

sonnet.problem: "So Ezekiel's on silent mode" tells a prediction as if it has already happened. In verse 26 God says "you will be silent" and "I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth."
sonnet.rule: A prediction stays a prediction: "God says Tyre will fall," never "Tyre falls."
